lead_raw_text:
The structure of Gd4Co4Si8 (reduced formula GdCoSi2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Fmmm (No. 143), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Co centers with eight Si neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement, Gd centers with twelve Si neighbors in a close-packed-like arrangement, and Si centers with nine neighbors (three Co, two Gd, four Si). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Co and Si polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between Gd and Si polyhedra.
